text:
DeployBot: preflight checks for RC-3 (model v1.14-quant) completed. Prompt-eval suite 'summarizer-v2' flagged a regression: 12/480 prompts failed the quality threshold, avg ROUGE-L delta -6%. Failing examples linked: https://ci.redwood/rc3/eval/1729001234
Mia Chen: saw that, thanks. Is the regression showing up in live traffic or only synthetic suite?
DeployBot: only in the prompt-eval suite runs so far. Failure concentrated on long-form numeric summaries and multi-paragraph compression cases. 3 hits exceed our high-sev threshold.
Alex Rivera: ok. Decision time — pin to v1.13 for affected routes, or stop the rollout? What is today's change window?
Priya Kapoor: release window opens 18:00 PST and is 2h. We have marketing notes tied to this release, can't slip past today without a customer comms. Propose we pin summarizer routes and continue rest of RC-3.
Sanjay Patel: can we do targeted routing? If so I'd prefer pinning summarizer-only to v1.13 to avoid full rollback. Bisect would still be needed to find root cause.
Jordan (QA): bisect estimate ~45min-1h if we limit to quantization-related commits. If we pin, we lose live signal for the offending change but keep customers unbothered.
Mia Chen: my vote: pin router for summarizer-related traffic (all /v1/summarize/*) to v1.13, proceed with RC-3 elsewhere, enable a 10% holdback to catch anything odd. Create a regression suite entry for the 12 prompts.
Alex Rivera: note: routing pin adds load to older nodes. Are we good with capacity?
Priya Kapoor: oncall confirmed capacity headroom. Approve pin+partial rollout. Please add a line in release notes: "Pinned summarizer model to v1.13 due to prompt-eval regression; investigation in progress."
Sanjay Patel: starting bisect now. Command: `deploy-cli bisect --candidate v1.14 --baseline v1.13 --suite summarizer-v2 --max-runs 6`. Will post intermediate diffs.
DeployBot: scheduling router pin for /v1/summarize/* -> v1.13 in 5 minutes. Infra alerted for burst capacity.
Jordan (QA): if bisect isolates a single commit we can craft a hotfix. If it doesn't, plan for full rollback.
Mia Chen: add the 12 failing prompts to qa-regress/summarizer-blockers and include expected outputs.
Alex Rivera: PR created: #4823 adds the failing prompts to the preflight and ties the eval to the gate. Link: https://git.redwood/pulls/4823
Priya Kapoor: monitoring plan: 30m post-pin snapshot for latency, error rate, and token-cost delta. If stable, greenlight remaining RC-3 promotion.
DeployBot: pin executed at 1729001270. Routing confirmed: /v1/summarize/* -> v1.13. Observability snapshot: https://dash.redwood/snap/1729001270
Sanjay Patel: bisect run 1/6 completed, narrowed suspect range to commit abc123..def456, running narrower tests now.
Jordan (QA): 30m monitor update: latency +3ms on pinned routes, token-cost negligible, no new errors surfaced.
Priya Kapoor: given the above, proceed with rest of RC-3 rollout. Release promoted at 1729001295. Keep thread open for postmortem notes and remediation timeline. :white_check_mark: 
Mia Chen: adding postmortem checklist and assigning owners: SPatel -> bisect/root cause, JQA -> regression tests, Alex -> release notes update, Priya -> customer comms if needed.
DeployBot: noted. If rollback required, run `deploy-cli rollback --release RC-3 --scope full`.
Sanjay Patel: will update with bisect conclusion in this thread. Thanks everyone. :pray:
